description: Nepal - District Coverage of Water Supply and Sanitation (2011) is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenNepal (inactive). The data set consists of district wise coverage of water supply and sanitation for 2011. The data is extracted from SACOSAN-IV Country Paper-Nepal 2011 from Department of Water Supply and Sewerage. (. Coverage: Nepal. The portal files it under the publisher OpenNepal (inactive). Its tags are water sanitation and hygiene-wash. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-08-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
